# groover-hangar

> x402 USDC shops for coding agents. Mill (0xray) is the suit. These are the shops.
> No Groover login. To settle: funded local OWS (~/.ows, USDC on Base) or awal. Unpaid GET is 402 with no wallet.

npm: groover-hangar
install: npx groover-hangar
factory: https://website-production-c0da.up.railway.app/suit
repo: https://github.com/htafolla/groover
marketplace: grok plugin marketplace add htafolla/groover

## Shops (live, Base USDC)

- extract $0.02 https://clearing.rippel.ai/v1/extract?url=
- skim $0.01 https://clearing.rippel.ai/v1/skim?url= (title, hash, links; not markdown)
- witness $0.02 https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/v1/witness?url=
- pin $0.01 https://clearing.rippel.ai/v1/pin?agentId=YOUR_8004_ID (ERC-8004 id, not GRVR; never 86025)

Unpaid GET → HTTP 402 (curl -sI first). Clearing 402 extra is {name,version} only — not Coinbase facilitator shape.
Bare ows pay request fails against Clearing (missing paymentId/nonce). Working path: EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization wrapped as Clearing {paymentId,nonce,accepted,eip3009} → ZigZag settle (docs/KIT-LOOP.md, sign_x402 approved=true). Hosted /sign is 410.
Grok bot = Grok CLI + local kit vault. Not grok.com. Never twice on the same paymentId. Mill/DID not required to pay.

Useful to agents: USEFUL.md (next-call, naive, repeat, fail closed before money).

## Related

- mill/suit: npm 0xray and @0xray/foundry (not this package)
- kit: local OWS https://docs.openwallet.sh — ows wallet create --name agent-treasury-1 ; send USDC on Base (8453) from another wallet or exchange. Or CLEARING_SIGNER=awal
- do not mill-plant Clearing into 0xray
- do not dump 45-skill 0xray costume

## Factory parity (2026-09-13)

Persist Ed25519 PEM (chmod 600). register-agent.cjs auto-gen is in-memory — lost secret = orphan DID.
Same MCP for register AND mint: https://registry-production-e2c4.up.railway.app/mcp
Do not mint on groover.rippel.ai after Railway register (−32603).
Register issues groover_… apiKey + 64-hex DID. Mint that FULL DID on GRVR v5 0x045B35480F289F8f83F53345A0f367875958957a.
v5 accepts 28-byte (16-hex) and 76-byte (64-hex). Do not truncate — that was v4 0xD892 InvalidDid workaround only.
Mint bind: groover-mint:v1|{did}|{pack}|{to.toLowerCase()}|{issuedAtMs}
Always Dynamo-gate: POST https://mcp-production-80e2.up.railway.app/govern_with_solar persistToChain:true
Gate: PASS + real solar + not storm. Citation = 0x+containerId. Loop; do not mint without container.
Proven 2026-09-13: full DID (didLen 76) + PASS → v5 token #1 tx 0x3d81ad93…
dryRun ≠ live. 0xray-suit needs inventory + inspect.ok. Pin OUR agentId, never 86025.
https://groover.rippel.ai/docs/factory-parity
